title: Purchasing Overview
description: Supplier spend and order pipeline — spend trend with month-on-month KPIs, top suppliers and items, and the open purchase order backlog.
notes: Built from posted AP Invoices (OPCH/PCH1), open Purchase Orders (OPOR), open Goods Receipt POs (OPDN) and Goods Returns (ORPD), cancelled documents excluded. The purchases-vs-returns chart requires the CVT_PURCHASE_VS_RETURNS_MONTHLY view (run scripts/sap_b1_finance_views.sql first).
